description:
SPEC (from the accepted cold review, scratchpad review/verdict.md; the
A+B prototype is in worktree wt-kdt127-review, review/protoB.diff = this
stage, 12 files +442/-137, clippy -D warnings clean; use it as reference,
rebuild from the spec with TDD).

Element: RuntimeTypePredicate.callables becomes a CallableShapes { targets,
shapes, exact } container mirroring fz-kdt.119's TupleShapes (targets
derived from shapes); a shape = (ClosureTarget, captures: [RuntimeType
Predicate]) recursing through the ordinary projection. ADMISSION of a
VALUE = CONTAINMENT of the value's construction shape in the arm's shape
(lattice closure-literal subtyping; never overlap -- fz-kdt.167). Arm
TESTS relate by overlap / erasing_overlap recursing into captures;
AxisPrecision for callables = PerPosition. Projection: callable_identity_
clauses / callable_identity_targets keep lit.captures (delete `captures:
Vec::new()`); anonymous literal -> CallableShapes::any(). Each
construction wrapper carries its projected shape (materialized where
Types exist). Native: NativeCallableBoundary gains `callable`, loses
`target`; callable_addresses ORs the wrappers whose construction is
CONTAINED in the arm shape; delete callable_boundaries_for_target + doc,
dead capture_key. Interp: backend_callable_identity returns the wrapper's
shape (select_dispatch_match already holds &mut Types, ir_interp/
backend.rs:634-648); delete the :2784 wrapper exemption. Capture unpack:
Prim::ClosureCapture carries `constructions: Box<[FnId]>` (identity_fns
of the wrappers minting the grounded layout -- a CallableId would invert
fz_ir->compiler2 layering, review F6); lower_closure_capture reads the
repr from those; keep the agreement check as a tripwire narrowed to them.

RED-FIRST: fixtures2/behavior/same_lambda_two_capture_types.fz (sl3 +
swapped order; red at base: interp 12.0, native refusal; Elixir oracle
12 / 11.0) and same_lambda_two_capture_types_dynamic.fz (closure chosen
by a runtime case then forwarded; GREEN at base -- the stage-A
regression guard; must gain a shape question at main's callsite). Unit:
containment admission (union-capture construction rejected by a narrower
arm), erasing_overlap recursing into captures, callsite_dispatch
a_nested_callables_captures_are_not_a_question INVERTED, runtime_
indistinguishable_arms_keep_the_order_they_arrived_in re-homed or
deleted (its pair IS this shape and now separates), residue pin 6 -> 0,
fz-kdt.157's witness (loosen the unpack to function-only -> the dynamic
fixture refuses).

EXPECTED MOVEMENT (measured on the prototype): corpus 9 canon movers, 0
executable/dispatch-count changes, +2 questions on 5 fixtures (+4 on
00277), 0 behaviour movers; compiler2:: 1300/4 -> all four are the
expected gate flips above. Docs: dispatch-matrix.md:65-85 + precision
row :270 + the 119 nested example; types/mod.rs:1596; surface.rs doc;
pipeline.md:29; fz-kdt.125's record corrected by comment. Not measured
by the review and REQUIRED here: full cargo test --lib, fixture matrix
--test-threads=1, corpus AOT, FIFO/LIFO lenses, fz-kdt.137 probes.

comments.text:
BUILT, one commit f34c2aaa3 on wt/kdt127-1-build (base 172ab21f1),
16 files +1032/-297 plus 6 new fixture files.

WHAT LANDED, against the spec. `RuntimeTypePredicate.callables` is
`CallableShapes { targets (derived), shapes, exact }` over
`CallableShape { target, captures: [RuntimeTypePredicate] }`, the
`TupleShapes` twin; the precision row is PerPosition and `axis_erases`
recurses into captures. Admission of a VALUE is CONTAINMENT
(`CallableShape::inside`, capture-wise `contained_in`), arm TESTS relate
by overlap / erasing-overlap. Projection keeps `lit.captures` in both
`callable_identity_clauses` and the new
`Types::runtime_type_predicate_callables`; an anonymous literal has no
clause to shape and reaches `CallableShapes::any()` -- the seam
fz-kdt.127.2 needs. Native `NativeCallableBoundary` gains `callable` and
`shape`, loses `target`; `callable_addresses` ORs the boundaries the test
ENUMERATES. Interp `backend_callable_identity` answers with the wrapper's
shape. `Prim::ClosureCapture` carries `constructions: Box<[FnId]>` (the
minting wrappers' identity_fns -- a CallableId would invert the
fz_ir->compiler2 layering) and `lower_closure_capture` reads the repr
from those, keeping the agreement check as a tripwire over exactly them.

GATES, all fresh from the final tree, markers quoted.
GATE-1788380187: `cargo fmt --check` clean; `cargo build --release` 0
warnings (forced, `touch src/lib.rs`); `cargo clippy --all-targets --
-D warnings` clean (verified to lint the lib-test target by planting an
`unused_variables` violation in drive_test.rs and watching it error).
GATE-1788380215: `cargo test --lib compiler2::` 1305 passed / 0 failed /
5 ignored; `cargo test --lib` 1581 / 0 / 5.
GATE-1788380346: `cargo test --test fixture_matrix -- --test-threads=1`
482 passed / 0 failed / 9 ignored (base 476/0/9; +6 = the two new
fixtures x 3 paths). The 9 ignored are enum_tier0, fz_f98_map_reduce and
enumerable_protocol_dispatch x {run, interp, build}, and the fixture
`defer.*` headers they come from are byte-identical to 172ab21f1's.

RED FIRST, measured by me at base (RED-1788378579, base binary rebuilt
from a `git archive 172ab21f1` tree verified byte-identical to HEAD's
src). `same_lambda_two_capture_types.fz`: interp `12.0 11.0 11.0 12.0`
where the Elixir oracle says `12 11.0 11.0 12` -- BOTH call orders wrong;
`fz2 run` and `fz2 build` refuse with "closure capture 0 of callable 73
has no single settled representation". At head, all three doors print the
oracle's four lines. `same_lambda_two_capture_types_dynamic.fz` is green
at base and at head.

RED FIRST for the two new lib gates, by reverting the mechanism.
Restoring the single deleted `captures: Vec::new()` line in
`callable_identity_clauses` turns
`compiler2_a_forwarded_lambdas_capture_layout_is_the_runtime_question`
red and the fixture wrong again (interp 12.0; JIT now faults at
`fz_closure_get_capture_f64 expected float, got Int(1)` -- the misroute
itself, which the construction-keyed unpack lets through to run).
Loosening `constructions_minting` to "any construction of the same
function" turns
`compiler2_a_capture_unpack_reads_the_constructions_that_minted_its_layout`
red and makes the native door refuse the fixture -- fz-kdt.157's refusing
half now has a program that reaches it.

MOVEMENT, three doors x 594 fixtures, base vs head sweeps taken with the
two binaries in this session. 28 output files differ; 25 are process/
thread ids, ASLR backtrace addresses, and one panic LINE NUMBER shifted
by this diff (jobs/native.rs 3424 -> 3443) inside fixtures that panic
identically at base -- byte-identical after normalizing exactly those --
and 3 are the new fixture's interp/run/aot going red -> green. ZERO other
behaviour movers.

CANON: 9 movers, exactly the predicted set, with executable counts and
`tail dispatch` counts UNCHANGED on every one.
 +2 questions, +9 lines: 00231, 00281, opaque_fn_value_join,
   repr_seam_enum_count_after_reduce2 (one lambda over two inner
   closures now separates) and a_mixed.
 +4 questions, +18 lines: 00277.
 text only, 0 line delta: 00275, closure_identity_captures,
   enum_predicate_search -- capture types now print inside the question,
   id-free, no plan structure moves.
 a_mixed also RESEATS: the wide `closure[reduce#L](closure[each#L](any))`
   arm takes seat 0 ahead of the grounded one. Sound (the wide surface
   contains the narrow), output byte-identical, and the consequence is
   that the exact specialization x23 is emitted and unreachable --
   fz-kdt.168's shape, measured.

STRESS. `FZ_STRESS_PERMUTE_DISPATCH` over {arms:reverse, arms:1, arms:6,
wrappers:1, wrappers:6, 1, 6}: 0 stdout movers over the 9 canon movers
plus the two new fixtures on all THREE doors (GATE-1788379771), and 0
over the whole 594-fixture corpus on interp (GATE-1788379776).

WALL CLOCK (GATE-1788379906): nothing above 1s. Top of the corpus is
enum_take_drop_split 0.43s, 00420 0.41, 00277 0.29, enum_map_family 0.28,
enum_predicate_search 0.27 -- the same profile as base.

DELETED, verified by grep at PROOF-1788380509 (0 hits each): the
`captures: Vec::new()` erasure and the "captures leave no trace" doc;
`callable_boundaries_for_target` + its "has to admit all of them" doc;
`NativeCallableBoundary.target` and the surface's copy;
`NativeCallableBoundarySurface.capture_key`; the per-FnId agreement rule
and its message; the interp `CONSTRUCTION_WRAPPER_IDENTITY_BASE == 0`
exemption in `direct_callable_capture_lanes`;
`callables: FiniteSet<ClosureTarget>` as the axis field; the
`Fn(u64) -> Option<ClosureTarget>` resolver signature; the precision
row's "honest only while ... compiles on no path" caveat, in
runtime_type_predicate.rs and in dispatch-matrix.md;
`INDISTINGUISHABLE_ARM_RESIDUE` and
`compiler2_runtime_indistinguishable_arm_residue_stays_pinned` (the pin
would have asserted zero of nothing; its five fixtures moved up into the
zero gate instead). `a_nested_callables_captures_are_not_a_question` is
INVERTED to `..._are_a_question`, and
`runtime_indistinguishable_arms_keep_the_order_they_arrived_in` is
re-homed on `%{a: int}` vs `%{a: float}` -- a map test is a kind check on
an Erasing axis, so that pair really is one question. TWO `Vec::new()`
capture sites SURVIVE and are correct: `fn_ref_lit` (a fnref closes over
nothing) and the multi-literal clause in `callable_identity_clauses` (an
intersection is not one shape; naming its literals over no captures
over-approximates it, which is the direction a test must err in).

DOCS: dispatch-matrix.md's envelope paragraphs and nested example
rewritten, the precision row rewritten, a `CallableShapes` section added
beside the `TupleShapes` one stating the containment law;
types/mod.rs envelope doc; surface.rs; callsite_dispatch.rs
`question_groups`; pipeline.md's construction-identity paragraph gains
the fact that the boundary carries the shape and the unpack reads through
the minting wrappers. fz-kdt.125's record corrected by comment.

ONE SPEC ITEM NOT DONE, and it is a refuted premise rather than a cut --
see the comment on fz-kdt.127.2. The spec asked for a unit gate proving
the dynamic fixture GAINS a shape question at main's callsite. It does
not, at this stage, and the review's table row that said so was inferred,
not measured (there is no headB/sl3dyn.canon in the review's artifacts).
Measured here on BOTH dynamic variants: the head canon is byte-identical
to base's. `P.run/2` and `P.twice/2` stay one body each over the union,
the call to `f` is indirect through the value's own word, and the
construction wrapper's own member selection answers -- which is why the
program is correct at base. The gate written instead is the one that IS
observable and IS the cure:
`compiler2_a_forwarded_lambdas_capture_layout_is_the_runtime_question`
asserts the STATIC fixture's forwarder callsite carries two arms naming
one function whose questions are disjoint.
